description: List delivered messages in a scoped inbox (id, thread, sender, subject, received time). Read-only; only policy-passed mail is returned. Requires the `read` capability.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call's next_cursor.

inbox_id.description: Inbox (mailbox) id. Must be in scope for the token.

query.description: Optional full-text/sender filter passed through to JMAP search.

name: mailbuttons_list_messages

status.description: Always "delivered"; rejected mail is never stored.

title: List inbox messages
